decisions.reason: The fruit-bottom yogurt draws directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how and won an award, though it has not been seen on the website since 2018 and flavour variants like this tend to rotate.
As the flagship flavoured cheese, it builds on established cheese competence that lets the firm read sales and refine the recipe, despite no website mention in 2020 to 2021.
A semi-hard wheel is a close extension of existing cheese production and the firm's own organic milk supply, so keeping it carries little risk.
The spicy line uses familiar cheese know-how, so individual variants are more likely to be trimmed than the whole line dropped.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the newer range and the firm can still build experience with it, although its visibility has faded.

Washed-rind soft cheese is technically furthest from the firm's core, the firm has no in-house research to improve it, and with no recent market signal its resources are better returned to core dairy.
